headline: PIT @ PHI matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is PIT 4.62 at PHI 5.13, with a projected total of 9.75. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward PHI: PIT moved +0.57 runs while PHI moved +0.75, changing the projected margin by -0.18 runs. The projected total climbed +1.32, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +12.2%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Bubba Chandler has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.0 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Brandon Marsh, Bryce Harper, Trea Turner, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Tyler Callihan because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
